observations: Nikon DSLR camera with a side-articulated LCD screen flipped open.
The camera has a prime lens attached with '50mm' and a distance scale visible on the barrel.
A tripod mounting plate is attached to the bottom of the camera body.
The mode dial includes PASM, Auto, and Scene modes.
Nikon branding is visible on the flash housing and the top of the body.
The camera body shows some wear on the grip and buttons.

claims.evidence: The model number is not legible in any of the provided photos.
The lens brand name is not visible in the photos.

risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a tool like 'myshuttercount.com' using a recent unedited photo.
risks.if_unproven: as high mileage, near end of expected shutter life

risks.proof: A clear photo of the sensor with the lens removed, or a test shot of a white wall at a small aperture (f/22).
risks.if_unproven: as having sensor defects or significant dust

risks.proof: A photo looking through the lens elements against a bright light source.
A photo showing the included battery and charger.
A short video showing the camera powering on, autofocusing, and taking a photo.

proof_requests: Photo of the front of the camera body clearly showing the model name (e.g., D5100).
Photo of the front of the lens showing the brand and aperture (e.g., Yongnuo 50mm 1.8).
Screenshot of the current shutter count.
Photos of the battery, charger, and any other included accessories.
response.reason: The specific model number is not visible in the photos. Nikon D5xxx series cameras look very similar but vary significantly in value; confirmation of the model and the lens brand is required for an accurate valuation.
